description: Start an async AI generation of any media type and return its job id. The input shape depends on the model (see list_models); for 3D prefer generate_3d. To run an image preset (list_models returns them: figurine, style, pose, convert), send mediaType "image", scene "image-to-image", options.image (the picture, or the subject then a reference), options.preset (its id) and optionally options.preset_addons and options.preset_background; the server composes the prompt, and prompt is then only your extra instructions. Bills credits: check the price with estimate_cost first. Pass a stable idempotencyKey when retrying — a retry with the same key replays the original job instead of billing twice. Then call get_job.

expectedCredits.description: The credits estimate_cost answered for this request. If the price has moved since, nothing is started or charged and the error (price_changed) gives the new price.

options.description: Model-specific options; derive from list_models (include_inputs). For an image preset: preset (its id), preset_addons, preset_background.

prompt.description: The prompt; with options.preset, only your additional instructions.

name: generate

deduped.description: True when an earlier call with the same idempotency key already started this job: nothing was charged again.

job_id.description: Pass to get_job to follow progress.

outputs.description: How many results this job makes.

status.description: pending and processing are running; success, partial, failed and canceled are final. 'partial' means some outputs finished and the rest were refunded.

title: Start a generation
